Roof 1.type_of_construction_eng: tilted roof with clay/straw filling between rafters

usual_refurbishment.measure_eng: insulate cavity between rafters (heighten rafters and clear interspace if necessary), total insulation thickness 12 cm
usual_refurbishment.measure_de: Dämmung im Sparren-Zwischenraum (WLS 035), Dämmstärke insgesamt 12 cm

advanced_refurbishment.measure_eng: insulate cavity between rafters + insulation layer, total insulation thickness 30 cm
advanced_refurbishment.measure_de: Dämmung im Sparren-Zwischenraum (WLS 035) + zusätzliche Dämmlage, Dämmstärke insgesamt 30 cm

Wall 1.type_of_construction_eng: masonry of natural stones or bricks

usual_refurbishment.measure_eng: add 8 cm insulation on inner surface (air-tight cladding, water pipes must not be conducted in outer brickwork)
usual_refurbishment.measure_de: Innendämmung 8 cm (WLS 035), luftdichte innere Verkleidung, im Außenmauerwerk dürfen keine Wasserleitungen liegen

advanced_refurbishment.measure_eng: if external insulation is possible: add 24 cm of insulation, creation of historical facade appearance (e.g. wooden shingles, plaster, strip tiles, ...)
advanced_refurbishment.measure_de: wenn Dämmung von außen möglich: 24 cm Dämmstärke (WLS 035), Herstellung einer historischen Fassadenansicht (z. B. Holzschindeln, Verputz, Verklinkerung, ...)

usual_refurbishment.measure_eng: add 8 cm insulation below / alternatively: on top of ceiling (in case of floor renovation)
usual_refurbishment.measure_de: Dämmung 8 cm (WLS 035) unter der Decke / alternativ: auf der Decke (im Fall einer Fußbodensanierung)

advanced_refurbishment.measure_eng: add 12 cm insulation below (in case of sufficient cellar height) / alternatively: on top of ceiling / combination of both
advanced_refurbishment.measure_de: Dämmung 12 cm (WLS 035) unter der Decke (bei ausreichender Kellerraumhöhe) / alternativ: auf der Decke (im Fall einer Fußbodensanierung) oder Kombination unter/auf

Window 1.type_of_construction_eng: box-type window: two single panes in wooden frames

usual_refurbishment.measure_eng: windows with double glazing, argon filled, low-E, historical impression (divisions)

advanced_refurbishment.measure_eng: windows with triple glazing, argon filled, low-E, insulated frame, historical impression (divisions)
advanced_refurbishment.measure_de: Fenster mit 3-Scheiben-Wärmeschutz-Verglasung und gedämmtem Rahmen, historische Ansicht (Teilungen)

usual_refurbishment.measure_eng: entry door with insulation layer (U = 1.6 W/(m²K))

advanced_refurbishment.measure_eng: mount new door with insulation layer (U = 0.8 W/(m²K))
